blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rains brought by a low pressure area (LPA) off Palawan are expected to ease as the weather disturbance moves westward toward the West Philippine Sea, the state weather bureau said Friday. The LPA, designated as 09e, was located over the coastal waters of Dumaran, Palawan, and was moving westward as of 5 a.m., according to Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather specialist Leanne Loreto. Loreto said the LPA was unlikely to develop into a tropical cyclone within the next 24 hours. It may dissipate once it moves over the West Philippine Sea. READ: LPA off […]...
